items.evidence: README headless command (examen leverage play work --ticks N --inputs ... --seed --settings) with --ticks 0/1/5 and no inputs printed {"tick":N,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":8,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":null,...,"walkers":null,"bolts":null}; all 12 keys of the brief present, tick equals N.
README frame command (--frame FILE --size 800x480) after 300 ticks, plus title/settings/play/pause/won/lost runs: every PNG has the PNG signature and IHDR 800 x 480.

Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 2:down,6:enter -> screen settings, texts [...,Settings, Volume: 8, Language: English, Back]; 0:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, guard_y 6.
In settings (volume focused) one right: 8->9; six rights: 10 (stops); fourteen lefts from 8: 0 (no wrap); texts show Volume: 10 / Volume: 0.

Down to Language, right: language es, settings texts [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir, Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Español, Volver] (no English). Next run same folder: title texts all Spanish; play texts [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5]; pause [Pausa, Continuar, Título]; lost [Has perdido, Puntos: 20, Enter: título]; won [Has ganado, Puntos: 450, ...]. Frames show the same.
Run 1 (--settings sp) set volume 5, language es; run 2 with same folder and another seed started at title with language es, volume 5 (settings.json written there); a fresh folder started with en, 8.
Holding up 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9.0; 60 ticks -> 12.0 and stays 12 at tick 200; down 30 ticks -> 3.0; down held 300 ticks -> 0 (clamped). Guard x is 2 in the frame.

Shoot held from tick 1: bolts appear at ticks 2, 26, 50, 74 (24 apart), x advances 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); bolt fired at tick 2 is gone by tick 80 (would be x>20). Tapping shoot/none every tick for 60 ticks gave only 3 bolts.
No input, tick-by-tick trace (--follow): wave 1 walkers spawn at x=20 on ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (90 apart) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6; x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); still exactly 5 walkers at tick 700.

Guard moved to y=2 and shooting: lane-2 walker health 2->1 at tick ~110 with the bolt removed, destroyed and score 0->10 at tick 129/135; bolts at y=4 passed the y=2 walker and hit the y=4 one; bolts at y=2.7 passed the y=2 walker (health stayed 2) while y=2.5 hit (0.6 tolerance).

Trace: walkers reaching x<=0 vanish and gate_health goes 5->4->3->2->1 at ticks 892, 982, 1072, 1162; at 0 (tick 2144) screen lost, texts [..., You lost, Score: 20, Enter: title]; lost frame shows the score.

Trace: wave 1's last walker gone at tick 1162; wave becomes 2 and its first walker appears at tick 1343 (181 ticks, 1 tick over 3 s); wave 2 spawned 7 walkers (1343..1883, none at 1973); texts 'Wave 2 of 5' / Spanish 'Oleada 2 de 5'.

My own --follow bot (seed 1, and seed 3 in Spanish) destroyed all 45 walkers (5,7,9,11,13 spawns counted): screen won at tick 5108, score 450, gate 5, texts [..., You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; Enter then gave screen title.

Escape at tick 100: screen paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; ticks 100-200 identical score/guard/walkers/bolts even with up+shoot held; Enter (Resume) -> play continuing from the same positions (walker 17.525 -> 17.5); Escape, Down, Enter -> title.
Same seed 1, 1500 ticks, same script, different settings folders: byte-identical output (md5 da7c9fb4...). Seed 2 lanes 4,8,4,2,8 vs seed 1 lanes 2,4,8,6,6; seeds 2 and 7 final states differ.

Play frame at tick 300 (Spanish): grey gate at left edge, blue guard at (2,6)->px(80,240), walkers at state x,y (40 px/unit, e.g. (12.575,2)->px(503,400)), damaged walker orange, bolts at x 15.3/9.7/4.1 on y=6, HUD 'Puntos: 0  Oleada 1 de 5  Puerta: 5'.

Frames: English title with Start outlined; Spanish title after Down with Ajustes outlined; English settings with Volume then Back outlined; Spanish settings with Idioma: Español outlined; Spanish pause with Título outlined. menu_index matches.
assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold every shown string (screens use @keys, lib.rs has no text); README 'Adding a language' says copy en.json to <code>.json, set locale/name, translate.

README 'How to play' covers keys for all screens; its headless and frame commands ran as written (only the --settings/--frame paths pointed at my scratch folder) and printed the state / wrote an 800x480 PNG, exit 0, with no engine started.

defects: The next wave starts 181 ticks (3.017 s) after the previous wave's last walker is gone, one tick more than 3 s.
The guard's centre is clamped to y 0..12, so at either edge half of the guard is drawn outside the field.
After returning to the title from a run, the report still shows that run's score, wave and gate_health (e.g. gate 0) instead of null.
Quit on the title does nothing visible in the headless run (screen stays title); could not see it in a window.
README commands put settings_dir and frame.png inside work/ (I redirected them to my scratch folder).
